title: Vortex thumbnails and media formats
items: YouTube search results show thumbnails and load more videos and songs as you scroll.
Open a selected or recent item's thumbnail to visit its original source.
Choose MP4 or MOV video, or extract audio as M4A, MP3 or WAV. New media exports no longer use MKV or WebM.
Run the Windows processor Update action on FUPCJ Server to activate search pagination and media conversion.
